summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology. I build embedded AI/ML software for edge devices, optimizing inference latency and memory footprint with TensorRT, ONNX and 8-bit quantization across NVIDIA Jetson and Cortex-M4 MCU targets. My firmware work spans bare-metal embedded C, RTOS task design and UART/I2C device drivers, connecting model runtimes to sensors and host applications in C/C++ and Python.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT, an OCR-free document-understanding transformer, on a custom medical billing dataset, improving validation accuracy from 55% to 93%.
Built preprocessing and training pipelines in PyTorch on the HuggingFace VisionEncoderDecoder API with domain-specific tokens and a resized decoder embedding layer.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 annotated images to 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation, then exported to ONNX and TFLite for edge deployment on constrained mobile hardware.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Built a wearable gesture-recognition glove integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with a Raspberry Pi and an HC-05 Bluetooth module, translating 3-DoF motion into HID commands on the host.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — M.S. Capstone, RIT
bullets: Integrated TensorRT-optimized YOLO for embedded AI/ML inference on NVIDIA Jetson, cutting per-frame latency from 56.7 ms to 10.9 ms (17.6 to 92 FPS, 5.2x over eager PyTorch) for real-time visual servoing.

Wrote the software interface between the AI/ML stack, firmware and sensors: Jetson-to-Arduino control over UART, dual VL53L0X ToF device drivers behind an I2C mux, and two-link inverse kinematics in C++ on the MCU.
Debugged 11 system-level integration failures across detection, firmware and sensor layers to reach 100% pick reliability over 10 trials; shipped the Jetson bridge as a systemd service.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Cut GPU memory footprint by ~55% via 8-bit quantization (LLM.int8()) on TinyLlama 1.1B, profiling peak VRAM and inference latency across prompt types with pynvml.
Benchmarked the compressed model on HellaSwag, GSM8K and ARC at under 1% accuracy degradation and +0.09 perplexity increase.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Ran YOLOv8 detection on NVIDIA Jetson and streamed tracking commands to STM32 firmware over interrupt-driven UART, coordinating RTOS tasks with FreeRTOS mutexes while driving multi-servo PWM control and VL53L0X ToF range sensing.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Programmed Cortex-M4 MCU peripherals from the datasheet in bare-metal embedded C (GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, I2C1) with timer-triggered ADC scans, interrupt-driven capture and a low-level I2C device driver, at 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM and a deterministic 1 Hz rate.
